drafts.content: The single‑head attention variant (row A with h = 1) achieved a development BLEU of 24.9 [AIAYN:T3:r02]. The papers do not state the development BLEU of the base configuration.
The model with a single attention head (row A, h = 1) obtained a development BLEU of 24.9 [AIAYN:T3:r02]. The papers do not state the development BLEU of the base configuration.
